class.name: HTMLLabel
class.description: Displays [member text] using [HTMLDocument]. Give the control a size with anchors, offsets, or a parent [Container]. The document wraps to the available width, and scrollbars appear as needed to reach overflowing content. Source changes are applied on a deferred update and reset the scroll position. Resizing recalculates the layout and clamps the current scroll offset. Connect [signal link_pressed] to handle navigation.

method.name: get_content_size
method.description: Returns the laid-out document size in pixels. Returns [constant Vector2i.ZERO] when there is no valid layout or the document is empty.

method.name: get_render_error
method.description: Returns the latest parsing or layout error, or an empty string on success. Errors are also shown in the editor as node configuration warnings.

method.name: get_scroll_offset
method.description: Returns the horizontal and vertical scroll offset in pixels from the start of the document.

method.name: set_scroll_offset
method.description: Sets the horizontal and vertical scroll offset in pixels, clamped to the scrollable range. If a layout is pending, the offset is applied after that layout.

members.member: Project resource directory used to resolve relative image paths. See [method HTMLDocument.parse] for the supported paths and image formats.
Additional CSS passed to [method HTMLDocument.parse] alongside inline styles and [code]<style>[/code] elements.
The HTML document or fragment to display.

signal.name: link_pressed
signal.description: Emitted when the left mouse button is pressed and released over the same visible link without dragging or scrolling. [param uri] is the link's original [code]href[/code].
